title: Mike Defensor, Joseph Espiritu to appeal denial of bail
summary: Former House lawmaker Mike Defensor and co-accused businessman Joseph Espiritu will appeal the denial of their bail petition by the Sandiganbayan Third Division.

blocks.text: Former House lawmaker Mike Defensor and co-accused businessman Joseph Espiritu will appeal the denial of their bail petition by the Sandiganbayan Third Division.
In a "24 Oras" report on Tuesday, the two co-accused, alongside Senator Rodante Marcoleta, petitioned for bail in their P75 million plunder case.
The anti-graft court denied their bail, and they remain in prison.
They said that together with Marcoleta, they were dismayed by the decision and will file a motion for reconsideration.
GMA News is seeking a comment from co-accused Aristotle Viray. —Jean Mangaluz/LDF, GMA News
